objective: Preserve existing BUKLOD PTT voice-first behavior by isolating optional caption listener failures and deferring chat network work until opened.
productionBaselineEvidence: The deployed Android OTA fingerprint has not been independently verified for this inspection. Main SHA 5efb99435243a4bcaeff27fc8d41d58b6a9969c2 is the authoritative GitHub source baseline, not proof of a production OTA. No native or OTA release allowed in this workstream.
chosenApproach: Fail open on optional Stream caption listener registration and lazy mount text chat only when Chat is opened.
selectionRationale: The newly introduced optional features should never stop Stream voice join or compete with first-frame mic/floor startup by opening extra database calls.
alternativeApproaches: Revert transcription/chat completely (rejected because unnecessary feature removal)
Fail open with lazy mount and keep PTT voice core untouched (chosen)
Start all chat realtime and rely on network prioritization (rejected: avoidable startup IO)
acceptanceChecks: PTT core, mic/floor, Priority/SOS, background, notifications remain byte-identical
Caption listener failure cannot propagate from connectTarget
Chat does not subscribe to Supabase until opened
TypeScript and focused regression run pass
